data.likely_cause: Null TARGETDATE values in the source data caused 3 records to be skipped during the 2026-04-26 job run, leading to incomplete data in the METADATA table for the expected TARGETDATE 2026-05-06.

contributing_detections.evidence: No TARGETDATE found in METADATA table | LLM: The ASCM Daily Data Check rule failed because the observed value for the target date was "None," while the expected value was "2026-05-06." Logs indicate that the most recent job on 2026-04-26 loaded data for the target date "2026-04-26," with 3 records skipped due to null TARGETDATE values.

data.correlation_summary: The ASCM Daily Data Check failure is related to the 2026-04-26 job run, where 3 records were skipped due to null TARGETDATE values. Logs confirm that only 841 of 844 records were loaded into the METADATA table, and the target date loaded was 2026-04-26 instead of the expected 2026-05-06. This incomplete data likely caused the rule failure during validation.
